scope: Read-only review of current R8 ObjectiveStart CLI, transport, subprocess tests, retained-original probe and S1/S2 instructions. No test, original process, model, kernel or device was run in this review.

conclusion.observed_r8_qualification: The checked-in R8 evidence records real unchanged-original admission/journal and continuous Session/Shell projection, using an isolated test issuer on source 25298f5d87cf3db90deefe9c0405ecd241dc6581, same-tree remote ca5e7d8473690df1bf7636de0808e58414c40abe.
conclusion.recommended_next_increment: Two real CLI-process termination regressions at the stdin-EOF boundary and after a verified complete UDS request, before any owner reply.

verified_contracts.claim: The CLI emits one LF JSON for ordinary Linux invocation and treats write failure as exit 74 after the underlying attempt; absent output is not a not-sent receipt.
Input acquisition is limited to 65537 bytes but waits for EOF outside the transport deadline; whole-child lifetime belongs to the trusted launcher.

The consuming transport retains original envelope ownership in memory. A positive write count followed by unresolved I/O or protocol failure remains SubmitUnknown; no semantic reconnect or replay exists.
Only exact source-specific pre-dispatch refusals are certain. Generic request_rejected remains unknown, and valid owner admission is separate from device-effect completion.

The original qualification probe already writes each original request before spawning the CLI, with file sync, rename and parent-directory sync; this is a controlled test producer, not an enrolled product request owner.
The original qualification caller checks complete parsed JSON identity and status/exit agreement. It does not reinterpret missing output as zero-sent.
Stopped-owner journal inspection requires a retained acknowledged anchor and read-only File. It is not a live-side ledger reader or online historical RPC.
S1 requires an existing issuer and original request owner. S2 separately handles publication history and effect terminal results; fixed f8 lacks the proposed online admission-history RPC.

current_test_coverage.gap: Child.kill() currently appears only in timeout cleanup (lines 74-87), where timing out fails the test. No CLI test deliberately kills the process at a verified request phase and accepts the resulting missing-output case as the expected fault.
current_test_coverage.historical_test_scope: Existing six subprocess tests are local scripted-socket contracts. R8 original-owner admission and journal qualification is separately archived; those counts are not added to this source review.

proposal.title: Exercise loss of the trusted CLI process at both sides of request transmission
proposal.classification: Small test-coverage increment; not a claimed production repair or durable S2 completion
affected_paths: services/hepta-os/RUN.md (only if needed to expose the focused command)

cases.name: killed_before_stdin_eof_has_no_complete_result
cases.setup: Spawn the actual feature-enabled CLI with its original raw input and explicit private endpoint. Keep the trusted caller's stdin writer open after writing the bounded compact envelope, so EOF has not occurred.
cases.action: Kill only that owned CLI child while it is still live and reap it using one Child owner.
assertions: Expected SIGKILL exit is recorded, stdout has no complete result, no UDS request was received, original input remains unchanged.
Absence of a result must not be manufactured into an exit-10/not_sent result. The test's external knowledge that no frame was sent does not change the caller's output contract.
cases.qualification: Pre-transmission process-loss case, not a production durable intent store.

cases.name: killed_after_verified_complete_request_keeps_missing_result_unknown
cases.setup: The real private fixture listener verifies the exact complete original request, then signals the test caller through a bounded handshake and holds its response.
cases.action: After the complete-frame signal and before the fixture responds, kill/reap the actual owned CLI. Keep the fixture/listener alive until this cut.
assertions: Expected SIGKILL and empty/incomplete stdout are recorded.
The fixture received exactly the original one frame and then observes connection closure; the listener backlog has no second connection.
Original issuer envelope and request/run/spawn identity remain unchanged; no replacement facade or replay is launched.
cases.qualification: Real subprocess/UDS loss after positive transmission. The scripted peer establishes neither original-owner publication nor production recovery.

constraints: Use explicit phase handshakes; do not use a sleep as proof that a write occurred.
Retain sole child ownership and bounded cleanup on success and assertion failure.
A transport timeout that wins before the intended kill invalidates that fault run; do not relabel it as the requested process-death result.
Do not change original Hepta, protocol, features, issuer, Session/Shell authority, kernel, or production storage.

durable_handoff.already_present: In-memory SubmissionAttempt retains the original raw envelope; the isolated original probe persists exact request bytes before invocation.
durable_handoff.still_required_for_product: The existing issuer/request owner must provide the actual pending-intent commit and recovery hook before enabling a product submit action.
durable_handoff.why_current_probe_is_insufficient: It has confirmed receipt anchors from successful controlled runs. A first publication whose receipt is lost cannot be negated using RunStatus null or repaired by bypassing the live owner journal.
durable_handoff.allowed_next_owner_seam: A separately reviewed original-owner API/host integration for admission history and pending request reconciliation, keeping original run/issuer/message/sequence/spawn and unknown state.
prohibited_substitutes: A new desktop-owned SQLite or journal
Automatic new run/request ID or generation rebinding after unknown
Live recovery/truncation of original journal behind the owner
